cover_headline: Rajamouli's Varanasi Reportedly Sets Record Telugu Theatrical Deal
facts: Varanasi's Telugu-states theatrical deal is reported at Rs. 300 crore by 123Telugu and Rs. 290 crore by other trade outlets, with official confirmation still awaited
RRR's Telugu-states theatrical rights were valued at around Rs. 225 crore
Varanasi is scheduled for a worldwide theatrical release on April 7, 2027, in multiple languages

end.headline: Rajamouli's Varanasi Reportedly Sets Record Telugu Theatrical Deal
end.line: The Mahesh Babu film's Telugu-states deal is reported at Rs. 290-300 crore, above RRR's reported Rs. 225 crore.
